metadata.task_description: Lift the plate above the table.

controller_interface.robot: single Franka Emika Panda 7-DoF arm, fixed base
controller_interface.end_effector: parallel-jaw gripper (Panda hand), two fingers, max opening 0.08 m; no suction
controller_interface.controller: OSC_POSE operational-space controller, delta commands in the robot base frame

action_space.scaling: per step, +-1 maps to +-0.05 m translation and +-0.5 rad rotation targets
action_space.gripper: continuous: -1 fully open, +1 fully closed; intermediate values give partial openings

observables: RGB cameras: exo_right_cam, exo_left_cam, ego_cam, gripper_cam

cameras.exo_right_cam: external camera, right side of the table, elevated, looking at the table centre
cameras.exo_left_cam: external camera, left side of the table, elevated, looking at the table centre
cameras.ego_cam: front camera on the far side of the table, facing back toward the robot, looking down at the table
cameras.gripper_cam: wrist camera on the gripper, looking down along the gripper's approach axis

metadata.capture: arm held still (zero delta, gripper open); frames at t = [0.5] s
